SRC-009:R001.text: CORE-001: ConfigStorage::load_from_file must carry load provenance (MissingFresh/LoadedCurrent/LoadedMigrated/MalformedBackedUp/MalformedBackupFailed/UnsupportedFutureSchema/ReadFailure); reject schema_version > kCurrentSchemaVersion as valid-but-unsupported without rewriting it; disable persistence for protected states so no save path can destroy the source.
SRC-009:R001.verification: ConfigLoadResult provenance + persistence gate implemented; test_config lifecycle regressions green; ctest 21/21 Release+Debug

SRC-009:R002.text: CORE-002: startup reconciliation must enforce the persisted autostart DESIRED state in both directions -- ON reconciles the owned Run value to the current exe, OFF idempotently removes ProTrail's own value -- so a transient disable failure cannot leave config OFF while HKCU Run still launches ProTrail.
SRC-009:R002.verification: reconcile_desired bidirectional autostart implemented; test_autostart green; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R003.text: CORE-003: every publication path that can change TrailConfig::enabled (direct checkbox, color preset, Restore All, apply_config/dev preset) must compare old vs new and run the ONE canonical history-hygiene transition exactly once, so stale disabled-period movement can never render after re-enable.
SRC-009:R003.verification: apply_app_config_transaction centralized Trail history hygiene; trail_lifecycle regressions green; ctest 21/21

SRC-009:R004.text: W2-001: readiness and ACK wait sets must be built by appending only non-null handles to a compact array, recording each real handle index at append time, so the protocol mutex stays watched even when the shutdown beacon cannot be opened; one shared helper for both phases.
SRC-009:R004.verification: build_wait_set compact wait-set helper with 2 new single-instance regressions; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R005.text: W2-002: a whole-AppConfig operation (Restore All / apply_config / dev preset) must be ONE Application-level controller transaction: capture old state, install the validated new config, apply Master/Trail/Click enable-edge invariants exactly once, reconcile Start-with-Windows desired state, and persist ONCE instead of serializing intermediate hybrids.
SRC-009:R005.verification: whole-AppConfig transaction with one persistence commit; gui tests updated; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R006.text: W2-003: DeferredCoalescer cancel/destruction must invalidate already-posted work (generation/alive shared state), so a queued callback can never execute after teardown or dereference a destroyed coalescer, and a request accepted after cancel belongs to a new generation.
SRC-009:R006.verification: DeferredCoalescer generation-cancel; deferred_coalescer_cancel_is_real_cancellation + destroy_before_drain regressions green; ctest 21/21

SRC-009:R007.text: W2-004: activation dedup must guarantee exactly-once per request across interleaved HWND_BROADCAST fan-out using bounded recent-request identity tracking shared by the interactive and quiet channels, marking a request processed before invoking user-visible handling.
SRC-009:R007.verification: RequestDedup bounded set (A,B,A safe) with new test target; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R008.text: W2-005: durable configuration must be loaded exactly once during initialize() and retained through run(), removing the second independent ConfigStorage::load_from_file() from run() so startup side effects and runtime/UI never derive from different snapshots.
SRC-009:R008.verification: single startup config load; run() second load removed; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R009.text: PERF-001: world-space effect geometry (Trail segments/sparkles, Click bubbles/particles, Hold/Wake) must be built ONCE per global scheduler frame into one bounded reusable frame record; each OverlayWindow consumes it with only transform, culling, Direct2D emission and presentation, and per-overlay dirty state skips BeginDraw/Clear/Present/Commit when already clear and not intersected (exactly one transparent clear on the frame content disappears).
SRC-009:R009.verification: FrameGeometry built once per frame; OverlayWindow frame consumer + OverlayDirtyState; 4 new PERF-001 regressions (1 build across 3 overlays, dirty contract, seam/negative bbox, global death); ctest 21/21 Release+Debug

SRC-009:R010.text: PERF-003: production trail tessellation must be deterministic and adaptive -- bounded by the existing 12-piece quality ceiling, driven by curve flatness, maximum segment length and bounded approximation error -- with the SAME canonical curve-walking policy for stroke and sparkle consumers, replacing the fixed 12-piece-per-span tessellation.
SRC-009:R010.verification: adaptive tessellation bounded by 12-piece ceiling, one policy for stroke+sparkle, retained reference oracle; benchmarks 350->349 vs 4188, 512->511 vs 6132; ctest 21/21 Release+Debug

SRC-009:R011.text: PERF-002: runtime visual updates from high-frequency analog edits stay immediate, while durable persistence is debounced for a restartable single-shot delay (~150-250 ms), flushed synchronously at shutdown, with one reuse persistence authority, failed writes retaining dirty state, and lifecycle/discrete operations remaining immediate.
SRC-009:R011.verification: restartable single-shot save debounce; burst->1 write + shutdown flush regression; ctest 21/21 both configs

SRC-009:R012.text: PERF-004: the render scheduler must pace from the exact chrono interval (1e9/fps) rather than rounded integer milliseconds, using Qt 6.8 QChronoTimer or equivalent, keeping frame_interval_ns_ as the pacing authority while preserving the immediate first frame and active-only operation.
SRC-009:R012.verification: QChronoTimer exact chrono pacing (setInterval(ns)+start); scheduler test asserts exact ns; ctest 21/21 both configs
